Ask questions instead of searching – the AI runs on your PC

The assistant reads the open document and answers with page references; clicking a page reference takes you straight to the passage. Ollama does the processing – on your own computer or on a PC on your company network.

  • Answers in the language of your question, each with a page reference
  • As an agent, it fills in forms and changes paragraphs or tables; you review everything before applying it
  • Memory: if you like, it remembers your personal details, encrypted on your PC
  • Scans without text: the assistant offers OCR first, then carries on with your question
  • In the office, one powerful PC on your network can run the AI for everyone

Edit text right in the PDF – the AI helps with the wording

Click a paragraph and type, in the document’s own font. GetVaultPDF reflows the paragraph, with hyphenation and justified text. Whatever follows moves along; whatever no longer fits flows on to the next page.

  • AI right at the paragraph: correct, shorten, make more formal, translate between English and German, or give your own instruction
  • Preview with the new line breaks before anything is applied
  • Bold and italics are kept, even when the AI rephrases
  • One click on Undo reverts the whole change

One stack in, separate documents out

Put the day’s mail into the document feeder in one go. GetVaultPDF detects where one document ends and the next begins: at blank pages, at separator sheets with a QR code or by the content, such as “Page 1 of 2” or a new invoice number. You check the suggestions in the preview and save each document separately.

  • Scan straight from GetVaultPDF, via the flatbed or the feeder, duplex too
  • Separator sheet to print, optionally with the name of the next document
  • File names from the subject line or document number, such as “Invoice RE‑2026‑118”
  • Works without AI; the preview marks uncertain spots with a “?” you can click

Images, video and audio – right in the PDF

Drag images, videos or audio files from File Explorer onto the page, or paste them with Ctrl+V. Images become a fixed part of the page and look the same in every PDF viewer: move them, rotate them freely, crop them, put them in front of or behind the text. GetVaultPDF embeds videos and audio in the file and plays them right on the page.

  • PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF and SVG – SVG as vector graphics, sharp at any size
  • Images already in the PDF too: move, replace, export or delete them
  • For watermarks and letterheads: place an image behind the text, opacity from 0 to 100%
  • Video (MP4, WebM, MOV) and audio (MP3, WAV, M4A) with a playback bar, no extra player needed
  • Other PDF programs with RichMedia support play them too; videos print as a still image

Open Excel and CSV without Office – and get totals that add up

Expense lists, bank statements and accounting exports appear as a clean table, with numbers formatted for your language. Ask “How much rent did we pay in March?” and GetVaultPDF calculates the exact total first – the language model doesn’t have to guess.

  • Excel (.xlsx, .xls), OpenDocument and CSV, password-protected Excel files too
  • Excel exports from banking and ERP portals that are really HTML, CSV or XML files are recognized
  • Total rows aren’t counted twice, invoice numbers aren’t added up

Fill in forms – yourself or with the AI agent

Click a field, type, press Tab to move on – even across pages. Or tell the AI assistant what to enter, such as “Fill in the transfer form: payee …, IBAN …, amount …”. It also recognizes boxes that are only printed on the page, as on bank transfer slips, and puts each character in its own box.

  • Every value is checked: IBAN including its checksum, BIC, amount, date and the number of boxes
  • Preview with traffic-light status: correct or deselect values, then apply everything in one step
  • Insert one of your saved signatures
  • Flatten the form: your entries become a fixed part of the page

See at a glance what has changed

Two versions side by side, scrolling in sync, every change highlighted in color and listed. Check, for example, whether the signed PDF still matches the Word draft.

  • Word by word across the whole document, regardless of page breaks
  • Replaced images and logos stand out too; scans are compared as images
  • Save the comparison report as a PDF

Find anything – and redact what’s confidential

Search shows every match with a text snippet and page number, in scans too once OCR has run. One click redacts all matches, such as a name or an account number.

  • Redacted content is removed from the file, not just covered up

What leaves your PC – and what doesn’t

Many PDF programs run AI and text recognition in the cloud. GetVaultPDF does both on your computer. Here is exactly what data goes where.

Internet

Only these connections

  • License activation, once: license key and a random device name
  • Downloads you start: installer, updates, Ollama and the AI model
  • Update check at startup: only program name and version, sent to GitHub – can be turned off

Never

  • Documents, file names or contents
  • Usage data or tracking
  • Cloud AI: even Ollama’s cloud models are blocked

Your own servers and devices, only if you set them up

  • AI server on your company network, local addresses only
  • Your own Paperless-ngx server
  • Scanners and printers

Your PC

  • Your documents and file names
  • Text recognition (OCR)
  • AI assistant via Ollama and its encrypted memory
  • Converting Word, Excel, emails and web pages
  • Redacting, signing, forms
  • License check after activation

Hidden instructions don’t get through

For emails and web pages, the AI only receives what is visible in the document. Invisible text, such as instructions disguised in an email, never reaches the model.

No tracking through remote images

When opening emails, GetVaultPDF doesn’t load any images from the internet. The sender won’t find out that you opened the message.

AI server on your own network only

If a PC on your company network runs the AI for everyone, GetVaultPDF only connects to addresses on the local network. It sends nothing to servers on the internet – not even when a VPN or proxy program disguises them as local addresses.

Frequently asked questions

Is GetVaultPDF available in English?

Yes. Under Settings › General › Language you choose English or German. With “Automatic”, GetVaultPDF uses German on a German Windows and English on any other; the change takes effect after a restart. The interface is in English, including the dialogs and the AI assistant; a few messages may still appear in German. The installer is in English.

The AI assistant answers in the language of your question. Page references in its answers appear as “S. 3” (German for “p. 3”), and AI summaries and the title and tag suggestions for Paperless are currently written in German.

Do I need an internet connection for the AI?

No. The AI runs via Ollama on your computer or on a PC on your company network. You only need the internet once, to download Ollama and a language model. Depending on your choice, models are about 5 to 19 GB.

What kind of PC do I need for the AI assistant?

16 GB of RAM is recommended. A graphics card with 8 GB of VRAM or more makes the AI much faster. GetVaultPDF shows whether each model will run well on your PC. In the office, a more powerful PC on your network can also run the AI for everyone.

Does the AI assistant remember anything about me?

Only if you want it to. With its memory, the assistant remembers personal details you give it. They are stored encrypted on your PC and never go to the internet.

Can I edit the text of a PDF?

Yes. With the “Edit flowing text” tool, you change existing paragraphs right in the document, in its own font and in bold or italics if you like. GetVaultPDF reflows the paragraph and moves whatever follows. The AI can correct, shorten, rephrase more formally or translate the paragraph; you see the result in a preview first.

Can others see the videos I embed in a PDF?

Yes, if their PDF program supports embedded media (RichMedia); other programs only show the still image or the speaker icon. The files are stored inside the PDF itself, up to 200 MB each. When printed, videos appear as the still image; audio isn’t printed.

Do I need Microsoft Office?

No. GetVaultPDF opens Excel and CSV files itself, and the Word export works without Office too. GetVaultPDF only needs Microsoft Office or the free LibreOffice to open Word and PowerPoint files.

Can I use GetVaultPDF without AI?

Yes. Ollama is optional. Scanning, text recognition, editing, forms and all other features work without AI.

What data is sent when I activate the license?

Only your license key and a random device name, once, to Lemon Squeezy. Documents, file names or contents are never transmitted. After that, GetVaultPDF checks the license on your PC only.

What happens after the 14-day trial?

Viewing, searching, printing, the AI assistant and sending to Paperless remain available. Editing, saving and exporting work again as soon as you activate a license. Your files stay unchanged either way.

Are updates included?

Yes, all version 1 updates are included in the price. From version 1.4, GetVaultPDF checks for a new version at startup and offers it to you: “Install Now” downloads the installer, verifies it and starts the installation. Your license and settings are kept. You can also install later or skip that version.

For the check, GetVaultPDF only asks GitHub for the latest version and sends the program name and version number – no documents, license or usage data. You can turn it off under Settings › General.

Version 1.3 and earlier don’t have the check yet: download the new version from this page once and install it over the old one.

Does GetVaultPDF work with Paperless-ngx?

Yes. “Send to Paperless” transfers the document to your own Paperless-ngx server, via its API or through the consume folder. The AI can suggest a title and tags (currently in German). Your access token is stored encrypted in your Windows user account.

Windows shows a SmartScreen warning during installation. Is that normal?

Windows warns about new programs from small publishers that don’t have many downloads yet. To start the installation anyway:

  1. Click “More info” in the warning window.
  2. Check that the file is shown as “GetVaultPDF_Setup_en.msi”.
  3. Click “Run anyway”.
